blocks.content: Mute timings are managed from the Notification policies page. In this milestone you navigate there and start creating a new mute timing.
To navigate to mute timings, complete the following steps:
In Grafana Cloud, navigate to **Alerts & IRM > Alerting > Notification policies** from the main menu.

On the Notification policies page, find the **Mute Timings** section (below the policy tree).

Click **Add mute timing** to start creating a new mute timing.
In the next milestone, you will configure the time intervals for your mute timing.
